name: Wazuh dashboard
summary: HTTPS 443 re-encrypted to the dashboard and checked on its login page.
notes: The dashboard only speaks TLS, with a certificate of its own that is not verified. /app/login is the one page that answers without signing in. Agents do not come this way: they report to the Wazuh server on TCP 1514 and enrol on 1515, which are services of their own.
